newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain Islamic Insurance Co plans to go public.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain Islamic Insurance Co plans to go public.

text.p: Bahrain Islamic Insurance Company (BIIC) plans to offer shares worth 500,000 dinars ($1.3 million) to the public in early 1997, a company official said on Monday.
The official told Reuters BIIC would be listed on the Bahrain Stock Exchange.

Bahrain's cabinet on Sunday agreed to convert BIIC into a public shareholding company from a closed company at the request of Commerce Minister Ali Saleh al-Saleh, the official Gulf News Agency reported.
The official said the company, whose activities include all types of insurance except life cover, has capital of 1.5 million dinars.
Set up in 1989, BCCI posted a 306,426 dinar net profit in 1995, he added. He gave no figure for previous years.
